Title: 490545-2026: Italy – Engineering services – Contract for engineering services for the works to extend the terminal lot 2B - preparatory works - ICT at Marco Polo Airport in Tessera Venice.
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Large, potentially complex building construction project (terminal extension) with likely long-span roof/structural tasks, therefore of interest for sbp. Deduction due to location in Italy and focus on architecture/ICT, which makes the purely structural share unclear.
titel: Engineering and architectural services for the extension of the terminal lot 2B with preparatory ICT measures at Marco Polo Airport Venice
kurzbeschreibung: Planning and site supervision services for the terminal extension at Marco Polo Airport in Venice.
umfang: Extension of the airport terminal lot 2B including preparatory ICT measures at Marco Polo Airport Venice; specific areas, spans, gross floor area or technical key figures are not stated in the notice.
leistungen: Architectural and engineering services for technical and economic feasibility planning PFTE, execution planning PE using BIM methods, site supervision as well as safety coordination in planning and execution CSP/CSE.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Airport project with potentially complex building and infrastructure character
• Early planning phases and execution planning with BIM offer a strategic entry point
• Possible relevance for structural concepts for terminal extensions, but without specific information on spans or special structures
• Tender covers services similar to general planning including site supervision and health and safety coordination, but not explicitly structural design
• Project in Italy is geographically generally interesting, but without particular watchlist relevance
• Lack of technical key figures limits the assessment of the fit with sbp
baukosten_erklaerung: The notice only states an estimated contract value for planning services of 1325359.19 EUR excluding VAT. No construction costs for cost groups 300/400 are given. A reliable estimate is not possible due to missing information on gross floor area, terminal size, type of construction, scope of fit-out, share of technical installations and construction phases. Roughly, a significantly higher construction volume in the double-digit million range would be conceivable for terminal extensions, but this cannot be realistically derived.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Registration in the relevant professional register and commercial register, relevant educational and professional qualifications, general annual turnover, references for comparable services, average annual staff; further requirements according to the tender documents.
auftraggeber: SAVE S.p.A., Viale Galileo Galilei 30/1, 30173 Tessera, Italy, E-Mail: gboscolo@grupposave.com, Telefon: 0412606688, Website/Vergabeplattform: https://save-procurement.tlk.app.jaggaer.com
notes: Negotiated procedure with prior call for competition in several phases. Language of the documents and submissions: Italian. Contract duration 6 months. Estimated contract value excluding VAT: 1325359.19 EUR. No award criteria stated in the notice; reference is made to the tender documents.
